skip_reason: Backend service unavailable at localhost:3001 — dynamic-mode specialists require running services

p1.title: GET /api/search endpoint unimplemented — 5 tests fail
p1.detail: The GET /api/search endpoint is not mounted in app.ts. 5 tests explicitly stated to fail until the route is implemented. The frontend DependencyPicker workItemsApi.searchItems() already calls /search?q=... — every typeahead search silently fails in production.
p1.fix: Implement and mount a /api/search route filtering non-deleted items by title/description.

p2.title: Missing dependencyCheckDuration Prometheus histogram
p2.detail: FR-dependency-metrics specifies 4 metrics. Only 3 counters exist — the dependencyCheckDuration histogram is absent, which is the most diagnostically useful metric.
p2.fix: Add new Histogram({ name: 'dependency_check_duration_seconds', ... }) and instrument isReady() / computeHasUnresolvedBlockers().

p2.title: pending_dependencies status missing — dispatch gating deviates from spec
p2.detail: WorkItemStatus enum has no pending_dependencies value. Implementation returns HTTP 400 at dispatch instead of parking the item. Any client polling for status === 'pending_dependencies' will never match.
p2.fix: Add PendingDependencies = 'pending_dependencies' to enum + transitions, update dispatch to set the state rather than reject, update onItemResolved cascade to advance PendingDependencies → InProgress.

p2.title: OpenTelemetry tracing absent — architecture rule violated
p2.detail: Zero OTel instrumentation exists in Source/. Logs do not include trace/span IDs. The W3C traceparent header is not propagated. CLAUDE.md marks this non-negotiable.
p2.fix: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node + auto-instrumentation init in app.ts; inject trace context into logger calls.
p2.cross_ref: QO-002 (observability gap), DEP-OTEL-001 (OTel version coordination in portal)

p2.title: Traceability enforcer validates only one plan — multi-plan blind spot gives false-green
p2.detail: The enforcer auto-selects the most-recently-modified requirements.md. Running against Plans/dependency-linking/requirements.md surfaces 7 untraced IDs. The CI gate python3 tools/traceability-enforcer.py gives false green.
p2.fix: Add --all flag to scan all requirements.md files, or enumerate plans explicitly in the gate command.

p3.title: Dual logger import paths in workItemStore.ts
p3.fix: Migrate workItemStore.ts to import from ../logger (shim) and update log call sites to object style.

p3.title: Silent .catch(() => ({})) lacks required documentation comment
p3.fix: Add comment: // Intentional: JSON parse failure on error body is non-fatal; fall back to generic status message

p3.title: OpenTelemetry version coordination — loose coupling in portal/Backend
p3.fix: Lock OTel packages together (npm update @opentelemetry/*) and pin in package.json during upgrades.

p4.title: Two undocumented eslint-disable suppressions
p4.fix: Add explanatory comments at each react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppression site.

p4.title: Large transitive dependency footprint in portal/Backend (577 deps)
p4.fix: Monitor quarterly for deprecated transitive packages with npm list --depth=5 | grep DEPRECATED

p4.title: React version split — Source/Frontend 18.3.1 vs portal/Frontend 18.2.0
p4.fix: Align portal/Frontend to react@18.3.1 in next release cycle.
